reason: A dsh plugin that bridges image messages to text-only models by generating vision-model descriptions and exposing them in the model-facing conversation context.

summaries.zh: 将图片消息转换为视觉模型生成的文字描述，使纯文本模型能够理解图片内容。
summaries.en: Converts image messages into descriptions generated by a vision model so text-only models can understand their content.

capabilities: Processes image inputs through a configured vision model
Makes external model calls using an existing configured provider route
Replaces model-visible image content with generated text descriptions while preserving the original in human transcripts
Provides an optional image-inspection tool for file paths and questions
